Footstep and landing recordings from the OpenSpades Free Pak
https://github.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/tree/1e6b28721a2e5e51f84a572d101079bf186c66d5

assets/audio/steps/stepA.ogg and stepB.ogg are Run1.opus and Run2.opus.
Artist: Disagree. Source: https://freesound.org/people/Disagree/sounds/433725/
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

assets/audio/steps/land.ogg is Land.opus.
Artist: MentalSanityOff. Source: https://opengameart.org/content/jump-landing-sound
License: CC0 1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The bundled Opus streams retain their original encoding. Playback mixes to mono and adjusts level and spatial placement.
